capabilities: Render board files as columns and cards
Add, edit, check off, archive and delete cards
Drag cards between and within lists
Create new boards and open boards from the file menu
extras: Manual installation only for now (copy main.js, manifest.json and styles.css into the plugins folder). Bases integration, editing of indented card detail lines, and collapsed-list rendering are not in this first build. No account, sync service or telemetry.
intentEvidence: if you have boards built with the original Kanban plugin (unmaintained since 2023
motivation: The original Kanban plugin is unmaintained and its repository is archived, so Boardflow keeps those existing board files working as they are.
problem: The original Kanban plugin has been unmaintained since 2023, leaving existing board files without a maintained way to be viewed or edited.

relations.evidence: if you have boards built with the original Kanban plugin (unmaintained since 2023

summary: Kanban board view that opens existing Kanban-plugin board files as plain Markdown, with no migration or new file format.
